s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive retinal vascular proliferation with macular edema resolution
salient_findings: Macular edema resolution after intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Hyperreflective tissues proliferating on retinal vessels on OCTA
Dendritic vascular-like structures on Fluorescein Angiography
key_facts: 76-year-old woman presented with macular edema
Treated with 2 intravitreal anti-VEGF injections
Macular edema completely resolved at 3 months
No recurrence of macular edema
OCTA findings showed hyperreflective tissues at 12 months
OCTA B-scan showed pyramid-shaped proliferations at 12 months
Hyperreflective tissues increased in size at 15 months
Angiogenic sprouts showed flow signals extending vertically at 15 months
Development observed in area of preexisting proliferation at 18 months
Enlarged horizontal structures along retina surface at 21 months
Fluorescein Angiography showed dendritic vascular-like structures at 21 months

shortlist.label: Proliferative Diabetic Retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive retinal vascular proliferation and neovascularization

shortlist.label: Idiopathic Juxtafoveolar Retinal Telangiectasia
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal retinal vascular proliferation and telangiectasia

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with macular edema and subsequent development of hyperreflective tissues, pyramid-shaped proliferations, and angiogenic sprouts on OCTA, along with dendritic vascular-like structures on fluorescein angiography, are characteristic of neovascularization seen in proliferative diabetic retinopathy.

rejected.label: Coats Disease
rejected.why: Typically presents unilaterally in young males, which does not match the 76-year-old female patient

rejected.label: Eales Disease
rejected.why: Characterized by retinal vasculitis and neovascularization in young adults, not fitting the patient's age and presentation

rejected.label: Retinal Vein Occlusion with Neovascularization
rejected.why: Would typically present with sudden vision loss and retinal hemorrhages, not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Idiopathic Juxtafoveolar Retinal Telangiectasia
rejected.why: Involves telangiectatic changes primarily in the juxtafoveolar region, not matching the widespread neovascularization seen in this patient
